decision: The competitor (Scuderia Ferrari HP) is fined €5,000.
fact: The team failed to physically return electronically returned tyres to the appointed tyre supplier before the start of Free Practice 2.
offence: Breach of Article B6.4.2 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 44 (Lewis Hamilton) who acknowledged the breach and attributed it to an oversight.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Ferrari Car 16 Return Of Tyres
to: The Team Manager, Scuderia Ferrari HP
